setup.description: Onboard your profile into the AI job search framework. Reads documents/ folder, imports a CV, or walks through an interview to build your candidate profile.

apply.description: Run the full drafter-reviewer application pipeline on a job posting URL or pasted text. Evaluates fit, tailors CV + cover letter, compiles PDFs, and ATS-verifies.

scrape.description: Search multiple job portals for positions matching your profile, deduplicate results, and present them sorted by fit score.

expand.description: Enrich your profile by scanning public sources (GitHub, portfolio, diplomas) for undiscovered competencies.

add-template.description: Register your own LaTeX CV or cover letter template in place of the stock ones.

add-portal.description: Generate a job-portal search skill for a job board in your market.

rank.description: Batch-score all newly scraped postings against the fit framework and return a ranked shortlist.

outcome.description: Record application results - interview stages, offers, rejections - and archive submitted materials.

interview.description: Build stage-specific interview prep pack with company research, likely questions, and STAR answer mapping.

html-report.description: Generate a self-contained HTML dashboard from your job search tracker and application archives.

notion-sync.description: Publish a one-way, read-only view of your job pipeline into a Notion database.

reset.description: Wipe profile data and/or documents folder to start fresh.

job-application-assistant.description: Career advisor and application assistant. Helps evaluate job postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prep interviews.
